name: Succubus
source:
A mature Succubus, she appears to be quite high ranking. Proud of her sexual prowess and control of her body, she is fond of showing off her abilities in front of newly transformed Succubi. Many adventurers faced against her are most likely squeezed to death.

Living most of her life as a wanderer, she seems to have settled down in Succubus Village disguised as a human. As the Ilias faith spread, more and more humans became reluctant to willingly have sex with Succubi. Due to that, she was forced into hiding, awaiting the day when Succubi are able to roam freely and have fun with men whenever they want.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
